mintAuthority.summary: gtUSDCp has three independent immutable Morpho vault deployments on Ethereum, Base and Arbitrum. Depositors receive shares for chain-local USDC, and the contracts can also mint fee shares during accrual. The inherited USDC MasterMinter remains parent exposure, not authority to mint vault shares or replace vault bytecode.

controls.label: Gauntlet USDC Prime Vault V2 Ethereum (immutable share accounting)
controls.capDescription: User shares are issued against deposited USDC; the contract also mints accrued performance and management fee shares. The verified immutable vault does not give its owner a direct arbitrary share-mint function. Owner 0xc684c6587712e5e7bdf9fd64415f23bd2b05faec is a 4-of-7 Safe.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25527215, the verified VaultV2 deployment had zero EIP-1967 implementation, admin, and beacon slots. asset() returned Ethereum USDC and owner() returned Safe 0xc684c6587712e5e7bdf9fd64415f23bd2b05faec, configured 4-of-7 with no modules or guard. The owner manages vault parameters but cannot replace the deployed bytecode.

controls.label: Gauntlet USDC Prime Ethereum owner parameter authority
controls.capDescription: Owner-held VaultV2 parameter and allocation authority; no arbitrary share mint or mutable-bytecode power is established. Selector-specific delays are not a blanket execution delay.
controls.evidence: Owner relationship as of Ethereum block 26095807 on 2026-10-01 is retained from the exact deployment review. It does not refresh the Ethereum USDC vault's runtime or allocation, or establish key custody, human independence or fallback noninterference.

capSemanticsReview.rationale: At Ethereum block 26112822 (hash 0x9a43012d71f59ade74c58a438ae4cf7eba960288f5357ddd8203d3a0ac51042a), verified VaultV2 runtime matches deployment and asset() is USDC. enter() transfers required assets before createShares(); accrueInterest mints formula-limited performance and management fee shares against existing vault assets, redistributing backed claims rather than creating arbitrary unbacked issuance. Fee parameters and adapter/allocation-cap administration do not expose a free share mint or minter-registration function. Base MetaMorpho and Arbitrum MetaMorphoV1_1 verified runtimes matched at blocks 48599296 (hash 0x95fc2dfcf0c1aa77e32e9041ffa6fe96376dbac823a27c3cdec6e909af5ae0e7) and 483587934 (hash 0x6ab358e298e48ceb34e6e4f8700ecae4bf7e41c3b57ae5fa5d79789c78ba8af4), with deposit-backed minting and interest-derived fee shares. Inherited issuer controls describe parent issuance carried by the serial-claim dependency edge, not wrapper-local share minting; parent D14 risk is not charged twice.
